title: Model Metadata and Prompting
summary: This module handles the retrieval and processing of model metadata, including capabilities and templating, and constructs prompts for various models based on user messages and model configurations.

nodes.label: Retrieve Model Metadata
nodes.title: Retrieve Model Metadata
nodes.description: Fetches and parses model configuration and template information from various sources, including GGUF files and manifest files.

nodes.label: Check Model Capabilities
nodes.title: Check Model Capabilities
nodes.description: Determines and verifies the capabilities of a model (e.g., tools, vision, embedding, image generation) based on its metadata and configuration.

nodes.label: Construct Chat Prompt
nodes.title: Construct Chat Prompt
nodes.description: Assembles the final prompt string for chat models, incorporating system messages, user input, images, and handling truncation based on context limits.

nodes.label: Render Prompt Template
nodes.title: Render Prompt Template
nodes.description: Applies Go templates or GGUF chat templates to format messages into a model-specific prompt, including handling image placeholders and tool calls.

nodes.label: Model Recommendations Cache
nodes.title: Model Recommendations Cache
nodes.description: Manages a cache of recommended models, used for API route registration and retrieval.

nodes.label: Model Show Cache
nodes.title: Model Show Cache
nodes.description: Caches model information for the 'show' API endpoint, refreshing when local manifest digests change.

nodes.label: Tokenize Prompt
nodes.title: Tokenize Prompt
nodes.description: External component responsible for converting text into tokens, used for context length management during prompt construction.

groups.label: Metadata Management
groups.title: Metadata Management
groups.description: Handles the retrieval, caching, and capability assessment of model metadata.

groups.label: Prompt Generation
groups.title: Prompt Generation
groups.description: Manages the construction and rendering of chat prompts based on model templates and user input.
